topics.topic: Fan-out delivery semantics when one target fails validation and others pass
questions: When one produced output fans out to multiple edges, and target validation fails on one edge but passes on others, are successful deliveries to other targets still performed, and in what order?

topics.topic: Refusal precedence when a request references both an ended run and an unknown approval/attempt
questions: If a decision request names both a finished run and an unknown approval/attempt, which refusal must be returned first: unknown reference or run-ended?

topics.topic: Run state and continuation handling if post-send outcome persistence fails after HTTP send
questions: If the second store call fails after the HTTP request was sent, what run state should be visible and how is continuation triggered before restart?

topics.topic: Startup behavior when service manifest/header data cannot be read or parsed during installed-instance checks
questions: If this start check cannot read or parse the selected service manifest data needed to obtain required headers, does startup fail, or is the check skipped/deferred?

topics.topic: Whether credential-vs-kernel header collisions are validated at startup and where that check runs
questions: At start, is a credential-header collision with kernel-set headers also checked and start-refused, and if so in which step/module?

topics.topic: Which module reads file input bytes to build read-operation requests in run_read_only_flow
questions: When a read-class operation node has file inputs, which module/capability reads file bytes for request construction in run_read_only_flow?
